items.summary: Dorsey's GrowSF questionnaire calls for a three-year plan to reach full police staffing, with faster hiring, combined recruiting and more civilianization.
items.title: Three-year plan to fully staff SFPD

citations.quote: Commit to a three-year plan to reach 100% full staffing, full stop.
citations.locator: Public Safety: What three things would you change about how SFPD operates?

items.summary: Dorsey says he is sponsoring legislation to change the section of the Surveillance Technology Ordinance that lets prevailing parties recover attorneys' fees from the city.
items.title: Change the Surveillance Technology Ordinance's attorney-fee provision

citations.quote: In particular, the section authorizing attorneys’ fees and costs recovery for prevailing parties in litigation is an irresponsible incentive to sue the city and its taxpayers
citations.locator: Your Policy Goals: Give three examples of legislation that should be repealed

citations.quote: and I’m sponsoring legislation to change it.

items.summary: Dorsey says San Francisco should work with other counties to create regional mental health treatment centers.
items.title: Regional mental health treatment centers

citations.quote: Ideally, San Francisco would collaborate with other counties to create regional mental health treatment centers.
citations.locator: Mental Health: Should San Francisco amend our current laws around mental health crisis intervention?
